GitHub's docs explicitly describe cloud and local sandboxes as isolated execution environments enabling Copilot to safely interact with code, tools, filesystem, and network resources, directly matching the story. Additional controls like MCP server allow-listing and audit logging reinforce sandboxed/governed operation.

missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the sandbox's isolation guarantees, and more detail on sandbox configuration/limits beyond the marketing description.
